responsibility: Defines the master sorted list of GCC debug counters through repeated DEBUG_COUNTER entries, serving as the shared source for the debug_counter enum, string tables, and other generated counter metadata. Its responsibility is declarative rather than executable: it names the transformation- and pass-specific probes that optimization code can test with dbg_cnt to gate individual events during debugging and bug localization.
same_name_distinction: This is the declarative X-macro source for the dbgcnt group: it contains the sorted DEBUG_COUNTER list that other files include to generate shared metadata. Unlike dbgcnt.h, which turns it into the public enum/API surface, and dbgcnt.cc, which uses it to build runtime tables and enforce limits, this file defines names only and has no executable logic.
